name: Business Understanding
goal: Decide if this is an AI problem, which pattern(s), success metrics, ethics, and ROI.
pmMoves: Translate a fuzzy 'we need AI' into a measurable outcome
Map use cases to the 7 Patterns
Reject non-AI work (rules, RPA, BI) when patterns don't fit
Set ethical constraints and human-in-the-loop expectations early
exitCriteria: A scoped iteration with a pattern, KPI, data hypothesis, and go/no-go questions.
failsWhen: Starting with a model because a vendor demo looked impressive.

name: Data Understanding
goal: Learn whether available data can actually support the question.
pmMoves: Inventory sources, owners, quality, and access
Hunt bias, leakage risks, and label coverage
Decide if you must collect or label more before modeling
exitCriteria: A data assessment: what exists, what's missing, what's risky.
failsWhen: Assuming 'we have a data lake' equals 'we have training data'.

name: Data Preparation
goal: Create trustworthy training material: clean, label, split, engineer.
pmMoves: Protect against leakage in splits and transforms
Invest in labels and rare-class coverage
Budget 60–80% of effort here without apology
exitCriteria: Reproducible datasets with documented lineage and a leakage-safe split.
failsWhen: Scaling on the full dataset then splitting, or shuffling time series.

name: Model Development
goal: Iterate models against the Phase I objective, not a Kaggle score.
pmMoves: Keep scientists from overfitting the test set
Prefer simpler models when they meet the need (explainability)
Track experiments; don't worship a single algorithm
exitCriteria: Candidate model(s) ready for honest evaluation.
failsWhen: Tuning until the test set looks perfect.

name: Model Evaluation
goal: Judge technical AND business/ethical fitness. Go, iterate, or stop.
pmMoves: Pick metrics that match costs of errors (not vanity accuracy)
exitCriteria: A documented Go / Iterate / No-Go with evidence.
failsWhen: Shipping because accuracy is 'high' on an imbalanced set.

name: Operationalization
goal: Put the model into a living system: deploy, monitor, retrain, govern.
pmMoves: Plan drift detection and retraining cadence
Treat MLOps as project work, not an afterthought
exitCriteria: Production path with monitoring, ownership, and feedback loops.
failsWhen: Calling the project done when a notebook reaches 0.92 AUC.
